2.175.4
LinearScale.GaugeMajorTickMarks
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The LinearScale.GaugeMajorTickMarks element specifies the major tick marks to display on a
LinearScale. This element is optional. This element is of type GaugeTickMarks.
The following is the parent element of the LinearScale.GaugeMajorTickMarks element.
Parent elements
LinearScale
The following is the XML Schema definition of the LinearScale.GaugeMajorTickMarks element.
 <xsd:element name="GaugeMajorTickMarks" type="GaugeTickMarksType" minOccurs="0" />
